tier1.RD_raw: |rating - product mean rating|, the mean includes this review
tier1.PR: share of the user's reviews rated 4-5, over ALL their reviews including this one
tier1.NR: share of the user's reviews rated 1-2, over ALL their reviews including this one

tier2.burst_ratio: product-day count of 1-2 star reviews over the product's median daily count
tier2.pos_burst_ratio: product-day count of 4-5 star reviews over the product's median daily count
tier2.negative_review_concentration: distinct products / count over the user's 1-2 star reviews
tier2.burst_text_similarity_to_peers: text similarity, computed only on negative-burst days (is_burst_day == 1)

not_in_family_but_related.vader_compound: text sentiment; correlates with stars but is computed from the text only
not_in_family_but_related.total_reviews: count of the user's reviews, no ratings involved
not_in_family_but_related.prod_review_count: count of the product's reviews, no ratings involved
not_in_family_but_related.time_since_product_first_review: dates only; can proxy for a campaign window
not_in_family_but_related.MNR: max reviews per day by the user, no ratings involved
not_in_family_but_related.BST: review within 3 days of the user's previous one, no ratings involved
